newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Westmoreland Q2 net loss vs profit.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Westmoreland Q2 net loss vs profit.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Westmoreland Coal Co filed a voluntary petition for reorganization under Chapter 11 in December 1996.

Net income for the second quarter of 1997 included $1,034,000 for reorganization legal and consulting fees, an income tax benefit of $158,000, a gain of $732 for the sale of assets and an impairment charge of $3.1 million related to the company's subsidiary, Corona Energy.
Net income for the second quarter of 1996 included $14,740 on the sale of assets.

Net income for the first six months of 1997 included a loss of $173,000 on the sale of assets, $1,784,000 for reorganization legal and consulting fees, an income tax benefit of $318,000 and an accrual of $1.2 million for black lung liabilities.
Net income for the fist six months of 1996 included a profit of $17,181,000 on the sale of assets and a loss of $14,372,000 for the cumulative effect of a change in the accounting priniciple.
The company also set aside preferred dividends in arrears of $1,222,000 for the second quarters of 1997 and 1996 and $2,444,000 for the first six months of 1997 and 1996.
Net income was calculated before the payment of preferred dividends; earnings per share were calculated after the payment of preferred dividends.
